spec_tile_note: docs/05_phase_plans.md asks for a 60x40-latent-pixel tile schedule; the Preset-A latent plane is 34x60 = 2040 pixels < 2400, so the schedule degenerates to ONE tile — no seams

halo.note: kH=kW=3 needs a 1-pixel halo; kT=3 needs 2 previous input frames (causal)

chunk_stream: each chunk's decode is independent of the previous chunk's frames (the DiT side carries the trajectory); the temporal cache is only within-chunk, so no cross-chunk VAE state is needed
